scope.subject: one owned source occurrence, with source-part fidelity retained

multiplicityAuthority.oneOfThree: NOT_ESTABLISHED: current DocumentTaskContract has no mutual-exclusion declaration.
multiplicityAuthority.independentFlags: CANDIDATE_ONLY: a fixed three-flag wire is finite, but needs an explicit task rule and an exact occurrence locator.

occurrenceFidelity.wholeAtom: ownedIndex handle is sufficient when the heading is exactly one whole owned atom.
occurrenceFidelity.strictSubstring: requires strict verbatimText plus optional occurrence under current V3.3 compact grammar.
occurrenceFidelity.multipart: requires primary ownedIndex plus ordered additionalSubjectParts; their selections may be strict substrings.
occurrenceFidelity.bareOwnedIndexAndFlags: INSUFFICIENT: cannot represent strict-span or multipart heading identity.

qualificationGate.responseVolumeProof: NOT_ESTABLISHED: removing relations alone does not prove a finite exact-span/multipart response fits 49,152 bytes.
qualificationGate.nextRequiredAuthority: Declare unary multiplicity and design a source-part-preserving occurrence-only response representation; then derive its source-constrained byte bound.

conclusion: P5Y correctly separates heading qualification from the relation lane, but an ownedIndex-plus-flags response cannot be frozen yet because it would discard the exact source-span and multipart fidelity required by the production-bound scoring axis.
